g.text: (encoder): the layers seen from one block of s(t)
(decoder): the same layers seen from the output
on one frame; moves on down / up
the window under the read head:
L1 AND conjunctions over the frame
the class of the last morpheme
L5 write units, one per value
the gate fans out: a demux
L5 keep units, one per value
the gate cuts the old value
x(t) the block of the frame
L5 read units, one per value
